Direct answer: The Larkspur bridge opened to traffic in 1962.

Key findings:
- The Larkspur bridge was approved for repainting, with work expected to take five months and close one lane at a time.
- Cyclists will be diverted to the upstream footbridge during the repainting.
- A ferry service began at the Larkspur crossing in 1931 and carried up to forty cars an hour at its peak.
- The ferry house still stands on the east bank and is now a cafe.
- The Larkspur bridge carries four lanes and a footpath on each side.
- More than six hundred runners finished this year's Larkspur bridge run.
